scope.included: Manual L1 look/reset and R1 camera-lock input arbitration in the normal gameplay camera producer.
scope.excluded: Telescope, cutscene, and setpiece camera-producer enumeration remains the broader E04 camera-system residual; it is not duplicated as an A17 closure condition.
scope.comparison_to_e04: E04 established the camera record and broad subsystem behavior. A17 uniquely closes the shoulder input decode, priority, parameter selection, recurrence, release lifetime, and normal-producer collision gates.

capsule_gate.search_result: No retained Phase-4 capsule or deliberate L1/R1 camera movie was available.
capsule_gate.escalation_reason: The missing domain was direct shoulder-input arbitration and release recurrence at the normal gameplay camera producer.

camera_fields.+0x22: low-byte normal active/control value plus signed high-byte countdown/control bits; not a stable mode enum

input_decode.priority: L1 is tested first; R1 is reached only when L1 is clear. Simultaneous L1+R1 therefore selects L1.

r1_parameters.effect: The common +0x20 writer receives zero angular step while R1 is held, so follow heading is locked without a separate persistent latch.

static_asm.distance_recurrence: camera +0x1E moves by 32 per camera update toward s3. The branch is not saturating, so the last step can cross the nominal target.
static_asm.countdown_recurrence: 0x8004DF40..0x8004DF5C extracts the signed high byte of +0x22 and subtracts one when nonzero. This corrects E04's provisional interpretation of values such as 0x0A01/0x0Bxx as stable submode enums.

collision_and_leash.region_query: 0x8004E3B0 calls camera_region_query 0x800376A0 while building the target.
collision_and_leash.candidate_solver: 0x8004E628 calls 0x8003633C only when the distance test passes and s5 is zero.
collision_and_leash.candidate_acceptance: Each candidate delta must have absolute value below 1024; otherwise 0x8004E6A8..0x8004E6C8 restores the prior target.
collision_and_leash.l1_behavior: The refreshed nonzero s5 bypasses the secondary candidate solver, but the earlier camera_region_query still constrains the target.

static_asm.callsite_bound: A C xref census over 2,258 ASM listings found the two calls to 0x8004DF18 in FUNC_8004EA8C. References and writers for special selector 0x800824DC reside in separate gameplay/setpiece paths.

live_control.logic_rate_observed: 10 producer executions during 20 video frames (30 Hz game logic)

l1_plus_r1.verdict: Matches L1 and proves L1 priority.

l1_plus_down.note: The 4035 value is 12-bit wrap during shortest-arc smoothing.

r1_move_release.verdict: The lock branch ends on release; camera geometry continues only through ordinary smoothing.

live_control.trace_integrity: All accessLog and execTrace buffers used for the cited trials reported truncated=false. L1 and simultaneous trials each hit the L1 body 10 times and the R1 body zero times.

closure.verdict: A17 is bounded-exhausted for manual camera controls and may move to Full.
closure.why: The input/state bindings, shoulder priority, look presets, distance and countdown recurrence, R1 angular lock, release lifetime, collision/leash gates, and caller boundary are all tied to pristine ASM and a hash-pinned Interpreter control.
closure.remaining_non_a17: Live telescope/cutscene/setpiece camera producer behavior and the full semantic reconciliation of 0x800824DC remain E04 work.
